description: T-056: drop the connection in the realm, log in again: the next-login notice pair, the room, the pack. The random hit-point loss is masked. Written for the differential harness, not yet run against the original. Walks to an unprotected room first; PUNHUP pinned to HIGH on both sides (see options).

mask.why: every direction name carries a random capital letter and a backspace, rewritten each slow cycle: `nJ\borth`
HP/mana in the prompt depend on earlier fights and regen
the hang-up hit-point loss is random

steps.note: to Newhaven, Narrow Path (1:2143), unprotected (room flags 0 in the stock WCCMP001), from the Village Entrance where creation-fsd leaves the character; a protected room would spare the punishment
drop the socket in the realm: the hang-up path
the two hang-up lines before the banner, then the hang-up room
the pack after: up to MAXHUPIT items gone, every second slot
hit points after the loss (masked: MINHUPHP..MAXHUPHP per cent, random)

options.why: PUNHUP must be the same on both sides: the module default is HIGH, the distributed WCCMMUD.MSG and silvermere ship NONE. Pinned to HIGH with MAXHUPIT 100 and the 25..50 per cent range.
options.applied: not yet: the harness has no per-scenario options; set them on both servers before running
